craft_notes: Sthāyin adbhuta (cosmic goose). Catalogue commas then dash-hold; colon lands on the song-act. Rejected: internal rhyme 'farer/prayer' — unneeded slant; dropped. Read aloud: farer held, sing released.

lines: Egg-bearer of the cosmos, of the sky-filler, the all-farer —
the High Swan's force: swanlike we sing.
l4.sanskrit_cite: brahmāṇḍagarbhiṇīṃ vyomavyāpinaḥ sarvatogateḥ parameśvarahaṃsasya śaktiṃ haṃsīm iva stumaḥ

reads_against.argmap: World-egg-wombing; of sky-pervading, of all-going, of supreme-Lord-goose. → Praise the goose-like power of the supreme goose.
c1_essence: Sthāṇu beyond minute and great; goose-power praised; groundless world-picture bowed.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti-vismaya (devotion charged with wonder); sthayibhava utsāha-in-bhakti

l2.plain_english: The world-egg-bearing one — of the sky-pervading, of the all-going, of the supreme-Lord-goose — that power, goose-like, we praise.
l2.sanskrit_cite: brahmāṇḍagarbhiṇīṃ vyomavyāpinaḥ sarvatogateḥ parameśvarahaṃsasya śaktiṃ haṃsīm iva stumaḥ

l3: Egg-bearer of the cosmos — of the sky-filler, the all-farer,
the High Swan's force — swanlike we sing.
reads_against.t1: Her who wombs the world-egg — of sky-pervading, all-going supreme-Lord goose — power: goose-like, we praise.
